Subject: Preliminary notes & room capabilities for Mar 30 workshop

Hi Jonas / Lauren,

Thanks for the initial details — excited to host the EnterpriseCo exec workshop on Mar 30. Attached are the venue floorplan and the power/wiring map. A few quick things I need to confirm so we can size AV and room assignments:

- Final headcount: confirmed in-person + remote watchers (separately for execs, engineers, and customer guests).
- Hybrid requirements: will you want a single live stream (Zoom) from the main room and mirrored feeds to the breakout rooms, or independent Zoom rooms per breakout?
- Recording & broadcast: do you want a multi-camera program feed (switcher) recorded and delivered post-event?
- Shipping & storage: will you ship any equipment or branded materials ahead of time? We can receive packages up to 3 days prior.

Attached: venue_floorplan_20260318.pdf, power_map_20260318.png

Vendor note: we have preferred AV partner CloudConf who can provide PTZ cameras, a 4-channel audio mixer, and an encoding box for the Zoom uplink. If you want, I can loop them in and get a quote.

Best,
Katie Hayes
Event Manager — Granite Venues

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-03-22T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Preliminary notes & room capabilities for Mar 30 workshop

Thanks Katie — quick answers and asks below. I included our onsite ops and travel lead so they can take action.

Headcount (tentative, subject to updates):
- Execs (in-person): 8
- Product & Eng (in-person): 18
- Customer guests: 6
- Remote viewers (internal + external): ~60 (watch-only)

Room plan we prefer:
- Main room (Room A, capacity 60): all exec sessions + keynote. Need program mix to Zoom + local screens.
- Breakout 1 (Room B, capacity 30): product demos — needs one participant mics and laptop HDMI.
- Breakout 2 (Room C, capacity 25): hands-on workshops — no streaming required but audio bridge to main room for Q&A.
- Overflow area (lobby): mirrored Zoom feed on large TV.

AV asks (high priority):
- Two PTZ cameras in main room (ceiling and rear) with switcher, program feed to Zoom.
- Table mics for execs (8) wired or wireless lavs — preference for wired to reduce RF risk.
- House audio integrated with mixer and recording to local RAID for backup.
- Redundant internet uplink or cellular bonding for the Zoom stream.

Logistics:
- We will ship a small equipment case (labelled REDWOOD — arrive Mar 27). Karthik, can you confirm shipping address and lead time?
- Need loading bay access from 07:00 on Mar 30 for early setup crews.

I've created a simple room matrix attached with who will be in each room and primary tech needs. Please confirm whether CloudConf is your recommended AV partner and share a ballpark quote.

Thanks —
Jonas
VP, Product Operations — Redwood Inference
Attachment: hybrid_room_matrix_20260322.xlsx (Excel)
From: CloudConf AV <av-tech@cloudconf.io>

Cc: Veronica Santos <veronica.santos@enterpriseco.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: AV proposal and quote for Mar 30 — program stream + breakout support

Hi Katie / Jonas,

Attached is our AV proposal and line-item quote for the hybrid setup you described. Summary highlights:

- Program feed: 2x PTZ cameras, Blackmagic ATEM switcher, Shure table mics for execs (8), audio engineer for run-of-show, live encoding box with 2x bonded internet modems for redundancy.
- Breakouts: 2x laptop HDMI capture devices for demo rooms, wireless presentation clicker, tabletop mic for audience Q&A where needed.
- Recording: Program file delivery (48-hour turnaround), local mirrored recording on RAID.
- Onsite crew: 1 lead engineer, 2 technicians, 1 runner. Setup earliest Mar 29 evening; full test Mar 30 at 07:30.
- Estimated cost: USD 12,400 (labor + equipment + redundancy).

DocuSign link for the AV order is below — signing secures the equipment and crew. If you need to reduce costs we can scope down to single PTZ + single audio engineer and remote streaming support (est. USD 8,600).

https://app.docusign.com/rooms/AV-Order-CloudConf-20260323

Attachment: av_quote_cloudconf_20260323.pdf (PDF)

Regards,
Alex Mercer
Lead Engineer — CloudConf AV

Katie / Alex — thank you, that quote looks reasonable. Please proceed with the CloudConf AV standard package (full program feed + two PTZs) on the DocuSign contract; Marissa will sign on logistics side.

Couple of final asks before we close the loop:
- Please provide a site contact (name + phone) for the loading bay and a gate code if applicable.
- Can you confirm whether the venue’s network supports jumbo frames and whether we can get a static IP for the encoder? If not, we need to bring the cellular bonding units as quoted.
- Please send a draft run-of-show (15-min granularity) by EOD Mar 27 so we can align cueing with our product demos.

Veronica — we’ll share final attendee list and dietary notes by tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Jonas
